# Tank Metrics

> 100 free, instant business and money calculators for entrepreneurs, students
> and small business owners in India. Every tool runs in the browser; no sign-up.

## Main pages
- [Home — all 100 calculators](https://tankmetrics.in/): valuation, EBITDA and margins,
  LTV:CAC and unit economics, burn rate and runway, EMI and loans, pricing,
  tax and wealth, real estate, and everyday money tools.
- [Blog](https://tankmetrics.in/site/blog.html): plain-English guides to startup metrics.
- [About](https://tankmetrics.in/site/about.html)
- [Contact](https://tankmetrics.in/site/contact.html)
